description: This file defines the PayloadMappingDefinition interface, which represents a mapping of payload definitions stored as a map of IDs to mapping contexts, including methods to retrieve, modify, and serialize the mappings.

classes.name: PayloadMappingDefinition
classes.description: An interface representing a set of payload mapping definitions with methods to access, modify, and serialize the definitions.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Returns the map of payload mapping definitions, where each key is a mapping ID, and each value is a MappingContext.

methods.name: withDefinition
methods.description: Creates a new PayloadMappingDefinition instance with an added or updated mapping for the specified ID and context.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no mappings defined; returns true if empty.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the PayloadMappingDefinition to a JsonObject, optionally with schema version and field selector.
